(rule!
  (let* ((colors (grid-colors g 0))
         (entries (sort
                    (map (lambda (color)
                           (list color (count-where (lambda (cell) (= (third cell) color)) (grid-cells g))))
                         colors)
                    (lambda (a b)
                      (cond [(not (= (second a) (second b))) (> (second a) (second b))]
                            [else (< (first a) (first b))])))))
    (list (for*/list ([entry (in-list entries)]
                      [_ (in-range (second entry))])
            (first entry)))))
